title: Sandbar Excursions with Snorkeling and Sunset Cruises in Key West
blurb:
Explore the beautiful waters of Key West with us, where the adventure includes snorkeling in crystal blue waters, lounging on secluded beaches, and witnessing stunning sunsets. This intimate charter accommodates up to 6 guests, ensuring a personalized experience. Choose from hourly, half-day, or full-day trips to tailor your Florida Keys getaway. Unwind and create unforgettable memories in paradise with a guided tour that showcases the essence of the Keys. 

- Snorkel in the clear waters of Key West with small group settings
- Relax on secluded beaches away from the crowds
- Enjoy breathtaking sunsets on the water
- Flexible trip duration options: hourly, half-day, or full-day
